## Safe-patching rule
- Only patch a gameplay value after its real serialized field has been identified with multiple independent checks (native field access, object layout, cross-instance consistency, and save/reopen validation).
- Map, level, object hierarchy, transforms and colliders are out of scope and must remain unchanged.
